# pvecli ceph versions

Ceph version of every daemon, to spot the ones left behind.

```text
pvecli ceph versions [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
